ios.desc:
Discover the World's Best Specialty Coffee Shops

Coffee Zip is your essential guide to finding and exploring specialty coffee shops around the world. Whether you're a coffee enthusiast, traveler, or simply looking for the perfect espresso near you, Coffee Zip helps you discover exceptional cafes wherever you go.

FIND COFFEE SHOPS NEAR YOU
Browse thousands of verified specialty coffee shops with our interactive map and location-based search. Filter by amenities like WiFi, outdoor seating, power outlets, and pet-friendly spaces. Discover hidden gems and popular roasters in your city or while traveling abroad.

DIGITAL COFFEE PASSPORT
Turn your coffee journey into an adventure with our unique digital passport feature. Collect stamps from every coffee shop you visit and track your progress across cities and countries. Watch your passport fill up as you explore new cafes and build your personal coffee story.

DETAILED CAFE PROFILES
Access comprehensive information about each coffee shop including operating hours, brew methods, specialty drinks, amenities, ratings, and reviews. View high-quality photos, check real-time locations on the map, and get directions instantly.

SEARCH BY BREW METHOD
Find coffee shops based on your preferred brewing style. Whether you love espresso, pour over, cold brew, French press, AeroPress, Chemex, or siphon coffee, discover cafes that specialize in your favorite methods.

SAVE YOUR FAVORITES
Build your personal collection of favorite coffee shops. Create wishlists for places you want to visit and keep track of the cafes that serve your perfect cup.

EXPLORE WORLDWIDE
Access our growing global directory of specialty coffee shops spanning major cities and hidden neighborhoods across every continent. From artisan roasters in Portland to traditional cafes in Rome, explore the world through coffee.

PERFECT FOR
Coffee lovers seeking quality specialty coffee
Travelers looking for local cafe recommendations
Remote workers finding coffee shops with WiFi and workspaces
Coffee tourists building their cafe bucket list
Anyone who appreciates craft coffee and unique cafe experiences

KEY FEATURES
Interactive map showing nearby coffee shops
Location-based search with distance tracking
Advanced filters for amenities and brew methods
Digital passport to collect cafe stamps
Detailed shop profiles with photos and information
Operating hours and contact information
User ratings and reviews
Save favorites and create wishlists

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I built Coffee Zip, an iOS app for finding specialty coffee shops and tracking your visits with a digital passport.

WHAT I'D LOVE FEEDBACK ON

1. Is the passport concept stupid or actually useful/fun?
2. How would you handle user-generated content (shops, reviews) without it turning into spam?
3. Monetization: Ads vs. subscription vs. one-time purchase?
4. Should I build Android or focus on making iOS perfect first?
